Chapter 6182: Finally Over

Chapter 6182: Finally Over

After losing the exchange, the strongest will of a primal ancestor pierced the sky and amazed all spectators, eventually disappearing on the horizon.

A meteor shower came next with countless resplendent streaks, drawing all inhabitants’ attention.

“Boom!” Immortal Suppressor’s grotto also collapsed—crystal pieces scattered in all directions, shining like diamonds.

“It’s over.” An emperor murmured.

“The era of Immortal Suppressor is over, the dynasty is no more.” Many touched their faces and tears streamed down inadvertently. They couldn’t quite describe their feeling.

“There is no more sin in Sin.” An apex emperor sighed: “Perhaps it is time to change the name.”

Moshi started Immortal Suppression Dynasty and declared this world as sinful. Now, the whole notion of sinners and their descendants was no more.

“A primal ancestor turned to nothingness.” A desolate god said as the lights above dispersed.

Everyone had lived beneath the shadow of Immortal Suppressor due to his cultivation and the support of his masters. The most brilliant cultivators in Sin couldn’t escape this shadow until now.

“What’s going to happen next? Will the same thing happen again?” A peerless genius whispered while staring at Li Qiye.

Everyone else did the same. Would Sin just have a new master? A supreme overlord would be unbeatable; his reign would last longer than Immortal Suppressor’s.

Therefore, those with ambition broke out in cold sweat due to their bleak future.

“That’s it.” Li Qiye said before looking around Sin.

Everyone lowered their head, not daring to meet his gaze. The ordinary man had become the supreme monarch of Sin, capable of sentencing anyone to death. A whim of his could decide their fate.

They thought about the worst - getting rid of an evil ruler to gain a ruthless tyrant.

“Time to leave.” Li Qiye said before raising the cauldron.

“Boom!” It shot a beam and forcefully opened a gateway.

“Old World!” Everyone watched the process.

“Let’s go.” Li Qiye smiled and entered the gateway. It closed after his entry amidst the confused crowd.

Everyone thought this would be Li Qiye’s era; it was time for them to live under his shadow. However, he had no intention of ruling and left without bidding goodbye.

“We were petty and misjudged him, how shameful.” A desolate god said after regaining her wits.

“A true dragon will not stay in a nest for ants.” An apex emperor felt the same embarrassment.

They forgot that Li Qiye was definitely above Sin’s level. What they worried about was their ambition of taking over Sin when possible.

“If an overlord wants to take over Sin, Immortal Suppressor wouldn’t have ruled for this long.” Another said.

“Young Noble…” The members of Enigma didn’t have the chance to say goodbye.

“We might be able to meet him again.” Chu Zhu told Six-style: “Now, it is time to rebuild Enigma.”

She ordered before leaving to enter isolated cultivation. She must become a primal ancestor and ascend to Old World.

“Enigma is being rebuilt!” This news spread across Sin overnight.

“So Enigma is the final winner, they will rise once more and rule.” A cultivator remarked.
